name: Family Bank Limited
source: Family Bank Limited audited consolidated and separate financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (Integrated Report and Financial Statements 2025, PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP, unqualified opinion), CONSOLIDATED (Group) column of the Consolidated and Bank Statement of Cash Flows, printed page 168. Filing prints Kshs 000, stored here in absolute KES (multiplied by 1,000). Every operating, investing and financing total is the printed line. Net increase in cash and cash equivalents is the printed 9,228,354 and 372,913 thousand, and the printed totals tie exactly: 1,088,142 less 803,402 plus 8,943,614 equals 9,228,354 for 2025 and 8,361,768 less 493,693 less 7,495,162 equals 372,913 for 2024; the printed opening balance 7,512,798 plus 372,913 equals the printed closing 7,885,711 for 2024. Capital Expenditure is the sum of the two printed investing outflow lines, purchase of property and equipment and purchase of intangible assets (software), 313,578 plus 506,474 for 2025 and 313,489 plus 180,204 for 2024, stored negative as this dataset stores capex, so 820,052 plus the printed 16,650 proceeds from disposal of assets equals the printed net cash used in investing of 803,402. Free Cash Flow is Operating Cash Flow plus Capital Expenditure.
source_note: The audited financial statements announcement does not include a statement of cash flows.
